readme: Controlled-break declarations for the eight existing BUG-025 scenarios.
The unchanged scripts/scenario-receipts.mjs runner applies each exact replacement only
inside an isolated working-tree copy, verifies the linked test selection, restores the
source, and emits current-revision red, implementation, green, live, and regression receipts.
Every find snippet is required to occur exactly once. A non-discriminating break is refused.

SCN-BUG-025-001.test: tests/company-intelligence-lab.spec.mjs#Regression: BUG-025 a never-answering corpus request reaches a bounded unavailable result
SCN-BUG-025-001.control: the declared-bound callback returns without aborting the underlying same-origin request, so the server never observes request closure and the carrier's abort-observed behavior assertion fails
SCN-BUG-025-001.claim: A same-origin corpus response that never answers is aborted at the declared read bound and settles as established with named unavailable coverage

SCN-BUG-025-002.test: tests/company-intelligence-lab.spec.mjs#Regression: BUG-025 an inside-bound response settles normally
SCN-BUG-025-002.control: a valid bar response released before the bound is classified unavailable after its real body is accepted, so the carrier's loaded corpus and current performance behavior assertions fail
SCN-BUG-025-002.claim: A valid response released inside the declared bound settles as loaded and is not classified as a timeout or unavailable response

SCN-BUG-025-003.test: tests/company-intelligence-lab.spec.mjs#Regression: BUG-025 a stalled served configuration preserves embedded first paint and settles
SCN-BUG-025-003.control: a bounded served-configuration transport failure is rethrown instead of retaining the validated embedded registry, so the route becomes terminally refused and the carrier's settled corpus reconciliation assertion fails
SCN-BUG-025-003.claim: A served configuration response that never answers preserves the validated embedded first paint and continues through bounded corpus reconciliation

SCN-BUG-025-004.test: tests/company-intelligence-lab.spec.mjs#Regression: BUG-025 synchronous fetch setup failure reaches existing unavailable state with zero timers
SCN-BUG-025-004.control: the synchronous fetch-setup rejection leaves its already-created bounded-read timer active, so the caller still reaches its named unavailable state but the carrier's zero-active-timers behavior assertion fails
SCN-BUG-025-004.claim: A synchronous request setup failure reaches the existing unavailable caller outcome without issuing the selected request or leaving a bounded-read timer active

SCN-BUG-025-005.test: tests/company-intelligence-lab.spec.mjs#Regression: BUG-025 late valid completion cannot overwrite a newer settled subject
SCN-BUG-025-005.control: the stale-intent comparison is removed while the route-terminal latch remains, so releasing the older MSFT response repaints or republishes over the settled AAPL reading and the carrier's named no-repaint and publication assertions fail
SCN-BUG-025-005.claim: A late valid response for an older subject cannot repaint, republish, or overwrite the newer settled subject and its horizon account

SCN-BUG-025-006.test: tests/company-intelligence-lab.spec.mjs#Regression: BUG-025 canonical company event path is requested once and exclusively
SCN-BUG-025-006.control: the exact canonical-subject predicate inside readEventSource() rejects company:msft before eventsPathFor() lookup, so the real route is refused and the carrier's composed established state, loaded financial-events row, and exact one-request ledger assertions fail without a runtime error
SCN-BUG-025-006.claim: The accepted canonical company subject authorizes exactly its subject-derived event document, requested once with no other event or off-origin request

SCN-BUG-025-007.test: tests/company-intelligence-lab.spec.mjs#Regression: BUG-025 embedded backslash authority refuses before transport
SCN-BUG-025-007.control: the strict declared-versus-derived event-path equality guard is removed, so the embedded backslash declaration is accepted and the carrier's named route-refusal, schema-code, and zero-route-transport assertions fail without an arbitrary runtime error
SCN-BUG-025-007.claim: An embedded backslash authority is refused with the fixed atomic C025-CONFIG-SCHEMA alert before route-owned or off-origin transport begins

SCN-BUG-025-008.test: tests/company-intelligence-lab.spec.mjs#Regression: BUG-025 served subject-path mismatch becomes terminal without continuation or focus theft
SCN-BUG-025-008.control: route-terminal refusal no longer hides the two settled result surfaces, so the served mismatch still reaches its safe refusal but the carrier fails only the named result-surfaces-hidden behavior discriminator
SCN-BUG-025-008.claim: A served canonical-subject and mismatched-path candidate becomes a terminal safe refusal with hidden settled surfaces, retained focus, and no corpus or event continuation
